description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a dependency class for query parameters and an endpoint that retrieves items from a mock database, demonstrating use of dependencies and query parameter handling.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A class representing common query parameters with defaults for querying items, including optional search and pagination parameters.

methods.name: __init__(self, q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Constructor initializing query parameters 'q', 'skip', and 'limit' with default values or provided inputs.

methods.name: read_items(commons: CommonQueryParams = Depends())
methods.description: Asynchronous FastAPI route handler that retrieves and processes query parameters, filtering a fake database based on them, and returning the result as JSON.
